statement_summary: One program aligned to CSF 2.0 implementing SP 800-171 on every CUI system
Group CISO accountable; division leads and Affirming Officials designated
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level; flight-safety and export risks rated High must be treated
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
SSP or annex for every CUI system; inheritance documented and confirmed yearly
Sanctions in proportion to intent and harm; CUI cases to ITPSO and Empowered Official
No flowdown, no CUI: DFARS clauses and SPRS and CMMC status checked before release
Intercompany services treated as external; CSPs holding CUI meet the FedRAMP requirements in DFARS 252.204-7012
Annual assessment of common controls and division samples; monthly POA&M review within 32 CFR 170.21 limits
SPRS scores and affirmations only after evidence check
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
Acquired sites isolated until due diligence and integration plan
Unique identities in the government-community tenant; no shared accounts
U.S.-person gating before any CUI access; access follows export tags
Role-based least privilege; Program H access limited to named staff
MFA for all CUI access; hardware keys for administrators; phishing-resistant for all CUI users by 2027-03-31
Service accounts owned, governed, and rotated
Termination within 4 hours; inactive accounts disabled after 45 days, including MES local accounts
Just-in-time privileged access through PAM; ticket-linked tenant support access
CUI only on registered external systems; public AI and personal cloud blocked
Vendor and machine vendor access only through PAM
Device compliance and certificate-based device authentication
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour, including on customer systems and GFE
One group severity scale and playbooks
DIBNet report within 72 hours per division with 2 certificate holders each
CSP duties to customers holding CDI in group platforms
Preserve images and monitoring data 90 days; malware to DC3
Disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K Item 1.05 within 4 business days of materiality determination
Export disclosure decisions and NISPOM reports recorded
Quarterly matrix review; annual cross-division exercise with every division reporting
Spillage handled with FSO and Contracting Officer
Classes and export tags for all information
CUI only in systems on the CUI location register
FIPS-validated encryption at rest and in transit
Government-related data used only to manage the operating environment
Registered encrypted removable media only; device control at USB transfer stations
Paper CUI locked, covered during visits, and shredded
Encrypted immutable backups with restore tests
No CUI, export-controlled, or Government data in unapproved AI tools
Awareness and insider threat training at hire and yearly
Software only from the group catalog, including CAD plug-ins
No CUI on personal devices or unregistered systems; customer CUI stays on customer systems
Never CUI in public AI; AI output never the source for dimensions, NC programs, or maintenance decisions
